[[File:Pyrefiend icon.png|left]]
'''Pyrefiends''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 30 Slayer to kill. They are the weaker elemental cousin of the [[waterfiend]], but are stronger than most [[icefiend]]s, except the ones at [[Ghorrock Fortress]]. They have similar drops to those of [[lesser demon]]s and [[harpie bug swarm]]s, and are notable for their relatively high drop rate for [[sealed clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scrolls]].

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Pyrefiends have high accuracy compared to many other monsters with a similar combat level. Pyrefiends are weak to bolts and to abilities and perks that affect [[demon]]s. [[Dwarf multicannon]]s can be used to fight pyrefiends in the [[Smoke Dungeon]] but not in the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]].

==Trivia==
* The pyrefiends in the [[Soul Wars]] tutorial have a [[life points|life point]] and are weak to crush. Nomad doesn't let players attack these though.
* Pyrefiends used to have significant stalling on their combat animations, causing them to appear in a different tile from where they actually were. This was reduced with their graphical update in 2014.
